title: Omen Visuals — Per-omen atmospheric effects
description: Apply subtle visual themes based on active World Omen. GOLDEN FEVER: gold tint overlay on pipes, star shimmer. HEAVY SKY: darker sky gradient, slowed star movement. OVERDRIVE: cyan tint pipes, faster star parallax. SHADOW REALM: pipe opacity oscillates (0.4-1.0 sine wave) creating fog/flicker effect. DIVINE GRACE: purple sky tint, gentle purple glow on bird. WINDFALL: occasional falling coin particles. CHAOS FLUX: pink/magenta pipe tint. Implement via omenVisual() helper that draws tint overlay after pipes. Keep subtle — gameplay readability > aesthetics.
